title: On Deleting two whole lines from the page
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：delete　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 delete 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the father ① deleted two whole lines from the page on the same day, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② deletes two whole lines from the page before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ delete two whole lines from the page at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ deleted two whole lines from the page before — a line in the letter for September 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Deleting two whole lines from the page on the same day, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ delete the name from the old list before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Delete the name from the old list at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ deletes the name from the old list on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ deleted two whole lines from the page again when nobody else would.

⑩ To delete two whole lines from the page, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody deletes two whole lines from the page before dawn again and somebody must delete two whole lines from the page on the same day all over again.

B. v. 删去（一般现在 deletes two whole lines from the page：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 delete 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the father deleted two whole lines from the page on the same day, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father deletes two whole lines from the page before dawn whenever the house asks.
Deleting two whole lines from the page on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever delete the name from the old list before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house deletes the name from the old list on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother deleted two whole lines from the page again, and the house remembered that half.
